description: The study planner's steps. The planner interface, the saved session history, and CONTENT_STATUS.md all read this file, so the step count is defined in one place. Ticking a step is the student's own checklist and is never evidence of learning. Only submitted answers produce evidence.

steps.title: Review a guide section
steps.uses: One section of the unit's review guide

steps.title: Answer practice questions
steps.uses: A randomized set of the unit's questions

steps.title: Review explanations for missed questions
steps.uses: Explanations for questions missed in the practice step

steps.title: Try missed concepts with different questions
steps.uses: Different questions on the concepts missed earlier

steps.title: Results and next step
steps.uses: A summary of the session's submitted answers
